east_catalysts_risks.notes: Thin result. Only one in-window item was verified: the Goodreturns Phase 4 piece of 27 Oct, which says the routes are still unapproved. I could not find these leads: Urban Acres Business Corridor interchanges (29 Oct), the Construction World KR Puram–Silk Board trials item (28 Oct), the Trade Brains Phase 4 and Blackstone pieces, the Panathur cremation ground protest, and The Bengaluru Live LED streetlight item. The searches did not surface them, and I did not try to fetch the Trade Brains or Bengaluru Live pages directly. Searches also found no dated October 2026 reports on STRR, suburban rail, Cauvery supply to the east, Varthur/Bellandur flooding or Whitefield/ORR leasing. The Blackstone lease (13 Oct) falls before the window and does not name Bellandur or Panathur, so treat that link as unconfirmed. The same search tool returned a summary that the Blackstone GCC opened on 27 Oct, but I did not see that on any page I opened, so I did not report it. The Deccan Herald page was blocked (403). Whether the Blue Line trials actually started by end-October is unconfirmed. Background items are marked with their true dates.

east_launches_prices.notes: I found no project launches or new phases in East Bengaluru published in the 27–30 Oct 2026 window. Search engines returned mostly undated broker or SEO pages, which I did not use. In-window items are the Phase 4 metro plan article (27 Oct) and the Blue Line trial article (28 Oct). The Blackstone lease (13 Oct) and the Arvind acquisition (28 Sep) are pre-window background. I could not find the Trade Brains Blackstone/Bellandur/Panathur article, the Panathur cremation ground protest, or the Kasavanahalli streetlight item. The Anarock Q2 2026 PDF could not be read. RERA Karnataka portal searches were not done. Godrej Whitefield Villas (Soukya Road) was described as pre-launch with RERA pending, but only by a weak blog, so I did not report it.

north_south_west.notes: Search tooling surfaced few in-window items. The Hindu pages (Pink Line Nov 15 inauguration, IKEA south store, Jalahalli underpass, Hebbal Lake road) were blocked, and no stronger source was found, so those leads are not reported as claims. Searches for the Devanahalli farmers' protest, the Supreme Court Hebbal order (₹20.31 crore), Hennur-Bagalur signal-free plan, KR Puram-Silk Board trials and the IKEA Konanakunte opening returned only older or unrelated material, so none is confirmed. No in-window villa or plot launches were found in Devanahalli, Doddaballapur, Hoskote, Kanakapura Road or Bidadi, and no in-window launches on Mysore, Tumkur or Magadi Road. Pre-window items seen but not reported: Sumadhura Panorama Phase II plots (Devanahalli, June 2026), Kalyani Kanakapura Road (portal page updated 24 Oct 2026), Century Astoria (10 Oct 2026). A broker blog (PropNewz, updated 26 Aug 2026) quoted Hebbal apartment prices of Rs 14,500-16,000/sqft, which is background only.
